title: Review Trigger, Cure Period and Reinstatement Waiting Period Schedule — Insurer Program Agreements
content:
Four figures set, per tier of the Insurer Program Agreements, when a performance review opens, how long the cure period lasts, what closes it and how long a suspended agreement waits:

| Agreement tier | Consecutive below-target scorecards that open a review | Cure period (calendar days) | Scorecards meeting every target needed within the cure period | Reinstatement waiting period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 2 | 90 | 1 | 90 |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 2 | 90 | 1 | 90 |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 2 | 60 | 1 | 60 |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 1 | 60 | 1 | 60 |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 1 | 60 | 1 | 60 |

## Definitions and zero values

- **Review trigger** — the consecutive below-target quarterly scorecards that open a review (a whole number; 0 means never).
- **Cure period** — the calendar days of the cure period that follows a review opening (a whole number; 0 means not applicable).
- **Cure scorecards** — the scorecards meeting every target needed within the cure period to close a review (a whole number; 0 means not applicable).
- **Reinstatement waiting period** — the calendar days a suspended agreement waits before it may be reinstated (a whole number; 0 means not applicable).

Under a Network Referral Agreement the trigger is 0, which means a review never opens, and the three other figures are 0, meaning not applicable.

## Reading across the tiers

- One below-target scorecard is enough to open a review under the Managed Repair Program Agreement and the Enterprise Master Services Agreement; two consecutive ones are needed under the Select, Preferred and Premier Direct Repair Agreements.
- The cure period and the reinstatement waiting period are 90 calendar days under the Select and Preferred tiers and 60 under the Premier, Managed and Enterprise tiers.
- Every tier that opens reviews needs 1 scorecard meeting every target within the cure period.
